2 روّب اللَّبَنَ , (S, M, A, K,) inf. n. تَرْوِيبٌ, (AZ, M,) He made the milk to be such as is termed رَائِب; (S, M, A, K;) as also ↓ ارابهُ : (M, A, K:) or he put the milk into the skin, and turned it over, in order that it might become fit for churning, and then churned it, when it had not thickened well. (AZ, M.) ＝
-A2- See also 1, in two places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
